verdict.rationale: Alloy's own marketing claims "fully auditable agentic automation" for AML and fraud checks, and its transaction-monitoring workflows generate alerts and investigations. That makes an agentic capability near this story plausible, but nothing shows an in-product agent actually investigating transaction alerts or drafting review notes. missing for 10: documented in-product agent that investigates transaction alerts, review-note or case-summary generation, first-party agent docs beyond a homepage tagline, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a ai-native, I can use an in-product agent to investigate transaction alerts and prepare review notes

citations.quote: Streamline perpetual KYC/KYB, AML, and fraud checks with fully auditable agentic automation
Monitors transaction events in real time or at scheduled times to detect suspicious activity, apply policy logic, and generate alerts or investigations when thresholds are met.
